# RBW Logistics

RBW Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. RBW Logistics provides nationwide warehousing, fulfillment, and transportation solutions backed by 60+ years of expertise. RBW Logistics employs 187 people (+22.2% YoY, +34 people) and has an annual revenue of $3.6M, founded in 1954. Headquartered in Augusta, Georgia, United States.

## About

We are a third-party logistics company headquartered in Augusta, GA with operations in Georgia and South Carolina. Our company specializes in serving the Southeastern region with world class logistics functions. We are not just a warehouse, a trucking company, or a trans-loader. Those definitions come with too many limitations and lack the creativity required to effectively manage today’s supply chain. What we do is something different. Something significant. Something more.

We are logisticians, strategic suppliers, supply chain engineers, trusted friends. We are a lot of things to a lot of people driven by a simple purpose: To simplify the supply chain.

At RBW, we change the way our clients think about logistics. We not only provide basic logistics functions, but we work closely with our customers to find creative solutions to problems to propel businesses to success. And, while this may sound nearly impossible, we have a good time doing it. 

Logistics is a huge field, and to play ball requires the right team of people consistently doing the right thing, right now. We need ambitious, honest individuals with a passion for excellence and a desire to succeed. If you think you fit the bill, then this may be the place for you.

results.text:
# RBW GRUPO - UNIDADE LIMEIRA

RBW GRUPO - UNIDADE LIMEIRA is a Outsourcing and Offshoring Consulting company. RBW Grupo is a company that provides complete outsourcing services in Mauá and Grande São Paulo, specializing in quality inspections, logistics, facilities, and production. They have their own team and ISO 9001 certification since 2013. RBW GRUPO - UNIDADE LIMEIRA employs 48 people, founded in 2013. Headquartered in Brazil, with offices in VINHEDO, INDAIATUBA, and MAUÁ.

## About

Uma empresa inovadora, pensada para facilitar o seu trabalho através de mão de obra qualificada e terceirizada, em empresas dos mais diversos segmentos, sendo nacionais e multinacionais. Atualmente contamos em nosso time mais de 1000 profissionais, distribuídos em 12 unidades, ao redor de todo o Brasil. Com mais de 50 empresas atendidas em 10 estados brasileiros. Nossa missão é a satisfação dos nossos clientes e sermos referência no atendimento à prestação de serviços. Nossa gama de serviços se compõem em 4 grandes áreas: Qualidade, Recursos Humanos, Logística e Facilities. Nosso portfólio de produtos e serviços tem o objetivo de oferecer a você soluções integradas, de acordo com as necessidades da sua empresa. Alcançando através de um projeto dimensionado para essas necessidades a simplificação dos processos e atividades da empresa, aumento de produtividade e qualidade e a consequente rentabilidade do seu negócio, gerando o retorno do investimento de forma acelerada. Clique para conhecer mais dos nossos produtos e serviços, ou entre em contato com a nossa equipe comercial para lhe atender de maneira personalizada!
